title: Kanlaon emits ash 4 times, triggers ashfall in Negros Occidental

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—Four ash emissions from Kanlaon Volcano on Sunday, Nov. 15, triggered ashfall in parts of La Carlota City and La Castellana in Negros Occidental, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported. The ash emissions lasted a combined 241 minutes and occurred at 6:15 a.m. for 67 minutes; 9:08 a.m. for 11 minutes; 9:32 a.m. for 65 minutes; and 10:49 a.m. for 71 minutes. The emissions generated plumes reaching up to 900 meters above the crater, said Mari Andylene Quintia, Phivolcs resident volcanologist at the Kanlaon Volcano Observatory in La Carlota City. READ: Mt.
